changelog: Two fixes on top of 0.0.99, one of them serious. The second battle could start with no army Fighting two battles in a row on a same-sized board could leave your whole force sitting in reserve with no roster panel to place it from -- and going out to the menu and back made the troops "reappear", which made it look random rather than reproducible. It was not random: a battle was recognised as fresh by a signature of seed, level and board size, and two consecutive fights could produce the same one. The second was treated as already in progress, skipped its opening reveal, and Auto Deploy -- which fires when the reveal ends -- never ran. Any arrival from the map or the menu now counts as fresh, and the engagement number is part of the signature. Small windows Reported from the Steam builds in a 1280x950 window, which is where all of this showed. Fog is seamless: one sheet per battle windowed continuously across the board rather than a different sheet per block, which never met cleanly at the joins; board cells also draw a pixel past their track so fractional-pixel edges stop drawing the table as a faint grid. The unit panel, roster and coach zoom follow the window instead of sitting at a fixed size. The map legend no longer runs under the node columns. Narrow titled frames put the header plate between the pillars instead of past them. The main menu is a true 3x2 grid, the Daily panel stops flickering on hover, and the demo notice is padded off its border. Quit is on the desktop main menu and flushes the cloud save before closing. The demo notice also fits a landscape phone now. Mac Universal (Apple Silicon and Intel), Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Minimum macOS 11. 1,241 tests.
